text:
tess: Flagging docs PR #5120: function-calling examples for /v1/generate show payloads with a top-level "tools" array but runtime currently emits a "tool_calls" object around the call. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120
omar: Yep saw that. OpenAPI schema still defines components/schemas/FunctionCall as { name, args } but examples embed it under "tools". Linter fails: example.rootKeyMismatch -> expected "tool_calls"
li: Which SDK snippets are impacted? I remember the JS streaming example uses `tools: [{name, arguments}]` in the request body.
tess: JS + Python snippets. The Python snippet uses keyword args like `tools=[...]` but the canonical JSON should use `tool_calls: { name: ..., args: {...} }`.
jen: My vote: canonical examples should reflect raw JSON the API accepts/returns (snake_case, tool_calls object). SDK language snippets can show the idiomatic mapping but with a small comment. E.g. in Python: # Request body key: "tool_calls"
docs-bot: CI: docs-lint reported mismatch in samples/openapi/generate-functions.yaml. Also flagged a snippet in quickstart/js/generate.md referencing the old shape.
omar: Quick patch plan: 1) update OpenAPI samples to use "tool_calls" 2) update code snippets (JS/Python) to keep idiomatic usage but add inline mapping comments 3) add a short migration note referencing previous "tools" examples.
li: Also check responses: server currently returns { "tool_calls": { "id": "call_1", "result": {...} } } but some docs showed an array of results. Need to standardize to object with single active call.
tess: I'll update the PR to switch examples and add a callout: "Legacy docs used \"tools\"; prefer canonical \"tool_calls\". The server will accept the legacy shape for 14 days."
jen: For SDK snippet adjustments: in JS show request as: ```js
// SDK: { tools: [{ name: 'search', args: { q: '...' } }] }
// JSON body: { "tool_calls": { "name": "search", "args": { "q": "..." } } }
``` and same idea for Python.
omar: I'll add a docs-lint rule: validate top-level example keys against the referenced OpenAPI schema. If mismatch -> fail CI. Saves future regressions.
docs-bot: Auto note: updated PR #5120 files touched samples/openapi/generate-functions.yaml and quickstart/js/generate.md
li: Reviewed updated snippets and left one nit on wording. LGTM after nit resolved. Thanks.
tess: Merged after CI green. Added changelog bullet: "docs: standardize function-calling docs to use 'tool_calls' object; legacy 'tools' accepted temporarily."
jen: Filing follow-up issue INFR-428 to sync SDK release notes and ensure mapping is mentioned in each SDK README.
